/* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.getGiveStateDetailListCntrUsePoint */ SELECT a.cntr_sn , a.use_sn , a.point_use_de , a.cntr_use_point , a.user_id , a.USER_NAME USER_NAME , a.LOGIN_ID LOGIN_ID , a.psitn_locgov_code , a.cntr_locgov_code , (select concat(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.psitn_locgov_code) as psitn_locgov_code_name , (select concat(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.cntr_locgov_code) as cntr_locgov_code_name , a.use_se_code , a.use_cn , a.order_code , a.url_adres , a.frst_register_id , a.frst_regist_pnttm , a.last_updusr_id , a.last_updt_pnttm FROM ( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , GC.use_sn , GC.point_use_de , GC.cntr_use_point , GC.user_id , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , GC.psitn_locgov_code , GC.cntr_locgov_code , GC.use_se_code , GC.use_cn , GC.order_code , GC.url_adres , GC.frst_register_id , GC.frst_regist_pnttm , GC.last_updusr_id , GC.last_updt_pnttm FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND cntr_sn = #{shCntrSn} ) a ORDER BY a.cntr_sn desc

/* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.getGiveStateModifyInfo */ SELECT a.cntr_sn , a.user_id , a.USER_NAME USER_NAME , a.LOGIN_ID LOGIN_ID , a.elctrn_pay_no , a.sttemnt_pay_de , a.cntr_de , a.cntr_amt , (select detail from op_common_code where id = a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code and code_type = 'RTNPSNT_REQST' and use_yn = 'Y') as rtnpsnt_reqst_code , a.cntr_point , a.cntr_blce_point , (select label from op_common_code where id = a.cntr_sttus_code and code_type = 'CNTR_STTUS' and use_yn = 'Y') as cntr_sttus_code , a.delete_at , a.psitn_locgov_code , a.cntr_locgov_code , a.seoul_trget_at , a.nts_sttus_mssage , (select CONCAT(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.psitn_locgov_code) as psitn_locgov_code_name , (select CONCAT(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.cntr_locgov_code) as cntr_locgov_code_name , a.mng_no , a.CNTR_USE_POINT FROM ( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , GC.user_id , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , GC.elctrn_pay_no , GC.sttemnt_pay_de , GC.cntr_de , GC.cntr_amt , GC.rtnpsnt_reqst_code , GC.cntr_point , GC.cntr_blce_point , GC.cntr_sttus_code , GC.delete_at , GC.psitn_locgov_code , GC.cntr_locgov_code , GC.seoul_trget_at , GC.nts_sttus_mssage , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GC.cntr_locgov_code,1,2) = '11' then (select to_char(sysdatetime, 'hh24missFF') || lpad(random() % 1000, 3, 0)) ELSE (select mng_htm5 from gif_stnd_buga_now where elct_pay_no = GC.elctrn_pay_no) END AS mng_no , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS CNTR_USE_POINT FROM G_CNTR GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND elctrn_pay_no = #{elctrnPayNo} ) a
mapper.update: /* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.sunapUpdateY */ UPDATE G_CNTR A SET a.cntr_point = case when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code = '100' then (a.cntr_amt * (select point_rate from g_ctbny_setup where locgov_code = a.cntr_locgov_code and stdr_year = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y') )/100 ) when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code ='300' then 0 end , a.cntr_blce_point = case when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code = '100' then (a.cntr_amt * (select point_rate from g_ctbny_setup where locgov_code = a.cntr_locgov_code and stdr_year = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y') )/100 ) when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code ='300' then 0 end , point_end_de = case when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code = '100' then DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(#{sttemntPayDe}, interval+5 year), '%Y%m%d') when a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code = '300' then null end , STTEMNT_PAY_DE = DATE_FORMAT(#{sttemntPayDe},'%Y%m%d') , cntr_sttus_code = '200' , delete_at ='N' , LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') where A.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{elctrnPayNo}
mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.giveReqmngInsert */ INSERT INTO G_CNTR_REQMNG ( REQ_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME, LOCGOV_CODE, STTEMNT_PAY_DE, CNTR_AMT, CNTR_REQMNG_CODE, DISCRIPTION, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, REQ_STATUS_CODE, CNTR_SN, TAX_SYS_CANCEL_DE, RELATED_DOC_DPT_NM, RELATED_DOC_NUM, RELATED_DOC_DE )VALUES( #{reqId}, #{loginId}, #{userName}, #{locgovCode}, #{sttemntPayDe}, #{cntrAmt}, #{cntrReqmngCode}, #{discription}, #{frstRegisterId}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '100', #{cntrSn}, #{taxSysCancelDe}, #{relatedDocDptNm}, #{relatedDocNum}, #{relatedDocDe} )
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.giveReqmngSmsUserInfo */ SELECT a.USER_ID , a.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , a.LOCGOV_NM , a.MBER_CI , a.CNTR_AMT , a.RECEIVE_SMS , REPLACE (a.PHONE_NUMBER,'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID , A.USER_NAME , CONCAT(UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , MBER_CI , B.CNTR_AMT , D.RECEIVE_SMS , D.PHONE_NUMBER FROM OP_USER A INNER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{elctrnPayNo} INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV C ON B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = C.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL D ON A.USER_ID = D.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ) a

/* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.giveReqmngSmsUserInfoByReqId */ SELECT a.USER_ID , a.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , a.LOCGOV_NM , a.MBER_CI , a.CNTR_AMT , a.RECEIVE_SMS , REPLACE (a.PHONE_NUMBER,'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT C.USER_ID , C.USER_NAME , CONCAT(D.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', D.LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , MBER_CI , B.CNTR_AMT , E.RECEIVE_SMS , E.PHONE_NUMBER FROM G_CNTR_REQMNG A INNER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.CNTR_SN = B.CNTR_SN INNER JOIN OP_USER C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV D ON B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = D.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL E ON C.USER_ID = E.USER_ID WHERE A.REQ_ID = #{reqId} ) a

mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.give.givestate.GiveStateMapper.insertGiveSunapInfo */ INSERT INTO G_NEXT_SUNAP_RESPONSE SELECT GC.CNTR_SN AS LINK_MNG_KEY ,BR.SGB_CD AS SGB_CD ,CONCAT(LOC.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM,' ',LOC.LOCGOV_NM) AS SGB_NM ,NULL AS TAXT_NO ,NULL AS UNTY_TAXN_NO ,BR.DPT_CD AS DPT_CD ,LOC.CHARGER_PSITN_DEPT AS DBT_NM ,BR.SPCL_FIS_BIZ_CD AS SPCL_FIS_BIZ_CD ,NULL AS SPCL_FIS_BIZ_NM ,BR.FYR AS FYR ,BR.ACT_SE_CD AS ACT_SE_CD ,CASE WHEN BR.ACT_SE_CD ='61' THEN '특별회계(시군구사업외수입)' WHEN BR.ACT_SE_CD ='41' THEN '일반회계(시군구세외)' WHEN BR.ACT_SE_CD ='51' THEN '특별회계(시도사업외수입)' WHEN BR.ACT_SE_CD ='31' THEN '일반회계(시도세외)' ELSE NULL END AS ACT_SE_NM ,BR.RPRS_TXM_CD AS RPRS_TXM_CD ,'고향사랑기부금' AS RPRS_TXM_NM ,BR.OPER_ITEM_CD AS OPER_ITEM_CD ,'고향사랑기부금' AS OPER_ITEM_NM ,NULL AS LVY_NO ,'00' AS ITM_NO , GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO AS ELCTRN_PAY_NO ,'01' AS RCVMT_NO ,'01' AS RCVMT_SE_CD ,'완납' AS RCVMT_SE_NM ,GC.CNTR_DE AS RCVMT_YMD ,GC.CNTR_DE AS ACT_YMD ,NULL AS TSF_YMD ,GC.CNTR_AMT AS RCVMT_PCT_AMT ,'0' AS RCVMT_ADTN_AMT ,'0' AS RCVMT_INTR_AMT ,NULL AS RCEPT_BANK_NM ,NULL AS RCVMT_TY_CD -- 위택스 수납관련 ,NULL AS RCVMT_TY -- 위택스 수납관련 ,NULL AS RSVE_ITEM1 ,NULL AS RSVE_ITEM2 ,NULL AS RSVE_ITEM3 ,NULL AS RSVE_ITEM4 ,'시스템 수납처리' AS RSVE_ITEM5 ,DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM G_CNTR GC LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV LOC ON GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = LOC.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN G_NEXT_SUNAP_RESPONSE SR ON GC.CNTR_SN = SR.LINK_MNG_KEY LEFT JOIN G_NEXT_BUGA_REQUEST BR ON BR.LINK_MNG_KEY = GC.CNTR_SN WHERE GC.CNTR_SN =#{cntrSn}

select nvl(DNTN_PATH,'합계') as DNTN_PATH, nvl(DNTN_PATH_CD, '999') as DNTN_PATH_CODE, GRAMT, TNOCS, GRAMTRT, RT from ( select nvl(a.DNTN_PATH, '합계') as DNTN_PATH ,nvl(a.CNTR_PATH_CODE, '999') as DNTN_PATH_CD ,a.AMT_SUM AS GRAMT ,a.CNTR_CNT AS TNOCS ,ROUND(CAST(100*a.AMT_SUM AS FLOAT)/NVL(b.ALL_AMT_SUM, 0),2) AS GRAMTRT ,ROUND(CAST(100*a.CNTR_CNT AS FLOAT)/NVL(b.ALL_CNTR_CNT, 0),2) AS RT ,LINK_INSTT_CD ,CASE WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND (DETAIL IS NULL OR DETAIL = '고향사랑e음' OR DETAIL = '') THEN 1 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = 'KB국민은행' THEN 2 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = 'NH농협은행' THEN 3 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '신한은행' THEN 4 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '액티부키' THEN 5 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '위기브' THEN 6 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = 'IBK기업은행' THEN 7 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '하나은행' THEN 8 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '웰로' THEN 9 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' AND DETAIL = '체리' THEN 10 WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '200' or CNTR_PATH_CODE = '300' THEN 98 else 99 END AS od from ( SELECT DNTN_PATH ,CNTR_PATH_CODE ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) as AMT_SUM ,count(*) AS CNTR_CNT ,LINK_INSTT_CD ,DETAIL FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND (occ.DETAIL IS NULL OR occ.DETAIL = '고향사랑e음' OR occ.DETAIL = '') THEN '고향사랑e음' WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = 'KB국민은행' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = 'NH농협은행' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '신한은행' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '액티부키' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '위기브' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = 'IBK기업은행' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '하나은행' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '웰로' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 100 AND occ.DETAIL = '체리' THEN occ.DETAIL WHEN gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 200 or gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE = 300 THEN '농협(오프라인)' END AS DNTN_PATH ,gc.CNTR_PATH_CODE as CNTR_PATH_CODE ,gc.CNTR_AMT ,gc.LINK_INSTT_CD ,occ.DETAIL FROM G_CNTR gc LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE occ ON occ.ID = gc.LINK_INSTT_CD AND occ.CODE_TYPE = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' and occ.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = 200 and cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} AND YEAR(gc.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(gc.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND '12' ) GROUP BY DNTN_PATH with rollup ) a, ( SELECT SUM(CNTR_AMT) as ALL_AMT_SUM ,COUNT(*) as ALL_CNTR_CNT FROM G_CNTR gc LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE occ ON occ.id = gc.LINK_INSTT_CD AND occ.CODE_TYPE = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' WHERE 1=1 AND gc.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = 200 and cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} AND YEAR(gc.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(gc.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND '12' )b ) order by od

SELECT TAKE_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, TAKE_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, TAKE_LOCGOV_NM, TAKE_LOCGOV_CODE, GIVE_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, GIVE_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, GIVE_LOCGOV_NM, GIVE_LOCGOV_CODE, GCNT as TNOCS, SUM_AMT, format((gCnt*1.0)/(sum(CASE WHEN give_locgov_nm = '소계' THEN gCnt ELSE 0 end)over(PARTITION BY take_locgov_nm)*1.0) * 100 ,1) AS TNOCS_RT, format((sum_amt*1.0)/(sum(CASE WHEN give_locgov_nm = '소계' THEN sum_amt ELSE 0 end)over(PARTITION BY take_locgov_nm)*1.0) * 100 ,1) AS AMT_RT FROM ( SELECT take_upper_locgov_nm, take_upper_locgov_code, take_locgov_nm, take_locgov_code, give_upper_locgov_nm, give_upper_locgov_code, give_locgov_nm, give_locgov_code, gCnt, sum_amt FROM ( SELECT take_upper_locgov_nm, take_upper_locgov_code, take_locgov_nm, take_locgov_code, give_upper_locgov_nm, cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} GROUP BY clg.upper_locgov_nm, clg.upper_locgov_code, clg.locgov_nm, clg.locgov_code, plg.upper_locgov_nm, plg.upper_locgov_code, plg.locgov_nm, plg.locgov_code ) AS t1 gCnt, sum(sum_amt) as sum_amt FROM ( SELECT take_upper_locgov_nm, take_upper_locgov_code, take_locgov_nm, take_locgov_code, '소계' AS give_upper_locgov_nm, '소계' AS give_upper_locgov_code, '소계' AS give_locgov_nm, '소계' AS give_locgov_code, gCnt, sum_amt FROM ( SELECT clg.upper_locgov_nm AS take_upper_locgov_nm , clg.upper_locgov_code AS take_upper_locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm AS take_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code AS take_locgov_code , plg.upper_locgov_nm AS give_upper_locgov_nm , plg.upper_locgov_code AS give_upper_locgov_code , plg.locgov_nm AS give_locgov_nm , plg.locgov_code AS give_locgov_code , count(1) AS gCnt , sum(cntr_amt) AS sum_amt FROM g_cntr gc LEFT JOIN g_locgov plg ON plg.locgov_code = gc.psitn_locgov_code LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code LEFT JOIN op_user_detail oud ON gc.user_id = oud.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND YEAR(gc.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(gc.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND '12' AND cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} GROUP BY clg.upper_locgov_nm, clg.upper_locgov_code, clg.locgov_nm, clg.locgov_code, plg.upper_locgov_nm, plg.upper_locgov_code, plg.locgov_nm, plg.locgov_code ) AS t1 ) AS tt GROUP BY take_upper_locgov_nm, take_upper_locgov_code, take_locgov_nm, take_locgov_code, give_upper_locgov_nm, give_upper_locgov_code, give_locgov_nm, give_locgov_code ) AS TTT

union all select '5월' as cate_month, 5 as od union all select '6월' as cate_month, 6 as od union all select '7월' as cate_month, 7 as od union all select '8월' as cate_month, 8 as od union all select '9월' as cate_month, 9 as od union all select '10월' as cate_month, 10 as od union all select '11월' as cate_month, 11 as od union all select '12월' as cate_month, 12 as od ) , month_data as ( SELECT case WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '1' THEN '1월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '2' THEN '2월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '3' THEN '3월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '4' THEN '4월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '5' THEN '5월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '6' THEN '6월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '7' THEN '7월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '8' THEN '8월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '9' THEN '9월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '10' THEN '10월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '11' THEN '11월' WHEN MONTH(CNTR_DE) = '12' THEN '12월' END AS cntr_month ,cntr_sn ,cntr_amt ,user_id ,cntr_de ,cntr_locgov_code ,cntr_sttus_code from G_CNTR where 1=1 and YEAR(CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) , total_summary as ( select count(md.cntr_sn) as Total_snCnt ,sum(md.cntr_amt) as Total_amtSum from month_data md where YEAR(md.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND md.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND md.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) select cateMonth as CATE_MONTH , snCnt as SN_CNT , round(t1.snCnt*100/(select Total_snCnt from total_summary), 1) as SN_CNT_RT , amtSum as AMT_SUM , round(t1.amtSum*100/(select Total_amtSum from total_summary), 1) as AMT_SUM_RT , uniqId as UNIQ_ID , od from ( select cm.cate_month as cateMonth , count(md.cntr_sn) as snCnt , sum(nvl(md.cntr_amt, 0)) as amtSum , count(distinct md.user_id) as uniqId , nvl(cm.od, 99) as od from categories_month cm left join month_data md on cm.cate_month = md.cntr_month group by cm.cate_month union all select '합계' as cateMonth , count(md.cntr_sn) as snCnt , sum(nvl(md.cntr_amt, 0)) as amtSum , count(distinct md.user_id) as uniqId , 99 as od from month_data md where 1=1 and YEAR(md.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND md.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND md.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' )as t1 order by od

SELECT MAX(AGES) AS AGES ,MAX(TNOCS) AS TNOCS ,MAX(RT) AS RT ,MAX(asum) AS ASUM ,max(od) as od FROM ( SELECT NVL(B.AGES,'합계') AS AGES ,COUNT(1) AS TNOCS ,ROUND(CAST(200*COUNT(1) AS FLOAT)/SUM(COUNT(1))OVER(),2) AS RT ,sum(b.cntr_amt) as asum ,CASE when b.od is null then 99 else b.od end as od FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 20 THEN '20대 미만' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 30 THEN '20대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 40 THEN '30대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 50 THEN '40대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 60 THEN '50대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 70 THEN '60대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 80 THEN '70대' WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) >= 80 THEN '80대 이상' ELSE '생년월일 없음' END AS AGES ,CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 20 THEN 1 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 30 THEN 2 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 40 THEN 3 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 50 THEN 4 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 60 THEN 5 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 70 THEN 6 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) < 80 THEN 7 WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,4)) - TO_NUMBER(A.BIRTHYEAR) >= 80 THEN 8 ELSE 9 END AS od , YEAR(A.CNTR_DE) AS CRTRYR , MONTH(A.CNTR_DE) AS CRTRMM ,a.cntr_amt FROM (SELECT A.CNTR_DE,A.cntr_amt, SUBSTR(OUB.BIRTHDAY,1,4) AS BIRTHYEAR, OUB.BIRTHDAY FROM G_CNTR A LEFT JOIN OP_USER_BIRTHDAY OUB ON OUB.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND '12' ) A WHERE 1=1) B GROUP BY B.AGES WITH rollup UNION SELECT '20대 미만' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 0 AS od UNION SELECT '20대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 1 AS od UNION SELECT '30대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 2 AS od UNION SELECT '40대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 3 AS od UNION SELECT '50대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 4 AS od UNION SELECT '60대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 5 AS od UNION SELECT '70대' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 6 AS od UNION SELECT '80대 이상' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 7 AS od UNION SELECT '생년월일 없음' AS AGES, 0 AS TNOCS, 0 AS RT, 0 AS asum, 8 AS od ) GROUP BY AGES order by od

SELECT ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_NAME ,PRICE ,SUM_PRICE ,SUM_QUANTITY FROM ( SELECT item_code as ITEM_CODE ,item_name as ITEM_NAME ,nvl(price, 0) as PRICE ,nvl(sumPrice, 0) as SUM_PRICE ,nvl(sumQuantity, 0) as SUM_QUANTITY FROM ( select OI.ITEM_CODE, OI.ITEM_NAME, OI.PRICE, sum(OI.sale_price * OI.quantity) as sumPrice, sum(OI.quantity) as sumQuantity FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI INNER JOIN OP_ORDER O ON OI.ORDER_CODE = O.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = O.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND O.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' INNER JOIN OP_ORDER_SHIPPING_INFO OSI ON OI.ORDER_CODE = OSI.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OSI.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE = OSI.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE INNER JOIN OP_ORDER_SHIPPING OS ON OI.ORDER_CODE = OS.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OS.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.SHIPPING_SEQUENCE = OS.SHIPPING_SEQUENCE JOIN OP_SELLER S ON OI.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID WHERE 1=1 and OI.ORDER_STATUS IN ('40') AND OI.CANCEL_FLAG = 'N' AND S.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} and YEAR(OI.CONFIRM_DATE) = #{crtrYr} group by item_code ) WHERE sumQuantity >= 1 ORDER BY sumQuantity desc LIMIT 30 ) UNION ALL SELECT '00000' as ITEM_CODE ,'총합계' as ITEM_NAME ,'' as PRICE ,nvl(sum(sumPrice),0) as SUMPRICE ,nvl(sum(sumQuantity),0) as SUMQUANTITY FROM ( select sumPrice ,sumQuantity ,'1' as flag_sum ,orderby_num() as row_num from ( select OI.ITEM_CODE, OI.ITEM_NAME, OI.PRICE, sum(OI.sale_price * OI.quantity) as sumPrice, sum(OI.quantity) as sumQuantity FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI INNER JOIN OP_ORDER O ON OI.ORDER_CODE = O.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = O.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND O.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' INNER JOIN OP_ORDER_SHIPPING_INFO OSI ON OI.ORDER_CODE = OSI.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OSI.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE = OSI.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE INNER JOIN OP_ORDER_SHIPPING OS ON OI.ORDER_CODE = OS.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OS.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.SHIPPING_SEQUENCE = OS.SHIPPING_SEQUENCE JOIN OP_SELLER S ON OI.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID WHERE 1=1 and OI.ORDER_STATUS IN ('40') AND OI.CANCEL_FLAG = 'N' AND S.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} and YEAR(OI.CONFIRM_DATE) = #{crtrYr} group by item_code ) where sumQuantity >= 1 order by sumQuantity desc ) WHERE row_num <= 30

WITH CURRENT_AMT AS ( SELECT A.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , A.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),1,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_1 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),2,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_2 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),3,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_3 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),4,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_4 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),5,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_5 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),6,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_6 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),7,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_7 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),8,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_8 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),9,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_9 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),10,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_10 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),11,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_11 , sum(nvl(DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),12,B.CNTR_AMT),0)) AS MON_12 FROM G_LOCGOV A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.LOCGOV_CODE = B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND B.DELETE_AT ='N' AND B.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND B.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND YEAR(B.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(B.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND #{crtrMm} WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, A.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM with rollup ) , UNIQUE_ID AS ( SELECT DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),1,B.user_id) AS MON_1, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),2,B.user_id) AS MON_2, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),3,B.user_id) AS MON_3, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),4,B.user_id) AS MON_4, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),5,B.user_id) AS MON_5, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),6,B.user_id) AS MON_6, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),7,B.user_id) AS MON_7, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),8,B.user_id) AS MON_8, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),9,B.user_id) AS MON_9, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),10,B.user_id) AS MON_10, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),11,B.user_id) AS MON_11, DECODE(MONTH(B.CNTR_DE),12,B.user_id) AS MON_12 FROM G_LOCGOV A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.LOCGOV_CODE = B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND B.DELETE_AT ='N' AND B.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND B.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND YEAR(B.CNTR_DE) = #{crtrYr} AND MONTH(B.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN '1' AND #{crtrMm} WHERE 1=1 ) select UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, NOW_YR_JAN, NOW_YR_FEB, NOW_YR_MAR, NOW_YR_APR, NOW_YR_MAY, NOW_YR_JUN, NOW_YR_JUL, NOW_YR_AUG, NOW_YR_SEP, NOW_YR_OCT, NOW_YR_NOV, NOW_YR_DEC from ( SELECT NVL(UPPER_LOCGOV_NM,'총계') as UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,NVL(UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, '99990') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ,NVL(MON_1,0) AS NOW_YR_JAN ,NVL(MON_2,0) AS NOW_YR_FEB ,NVL(MON_3,0) AS NOW_YR_MAR ,NVL(MON_4,0) AS NOW_YR_APR ,NVL(MON_5,0) AS NOW_YR_MAY ,NVL(MON_6,0) AS NOW_YR_JUN ,NVL(MON_7,0) AS NOW_YR_JUL ,NVL(MON_8,0) AS NOW_YR_AUG ,NVL(MON_9,0) AS NOW_YR_SEP ,NVL(MON_10,0) AS NOW_YR_OCT ,NVL(MON_11,0) AS NOW_YR_NOV ,NVL(MON_12,0) AS NOW_YR_DEC FROM CURRENT_AMT GROUP BY UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ) union all select UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, NOW_YR_JAN, NOW_YR_FEB, NOW_YR_MAR, NOW_YR_APR, NOW_YR_MAY, NOW_YR_JUN, NOW_YR_JUL, NOW_YR_AUG, NOW_YR_SEP, NOW_YR_OCT, NOW_YR_NOV, NOW_YR_DEC from ( select '고유ID개수' as UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,'99999' as UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ,(select count(distinct mon_1) from unique_id where mon_1 is not null) as NOW_YR_JAN ,(select count(distinct mon_2) from unique_id where mon_2 is not null) as NOW_YR_FEB ,(select count(distinct mon_3) from unique_id where mon_3 is not null) as NOW_YR_MAR ,(select count(distinct mon_4) from unique_id where mon_4 is not null) as NOW_YR_APR ,(select count(distinct mon_5) from unique_id where mon_5 is not null) as NOW_YR_MAY ,(select count(distinct mon_6) from unique_id where mon_6 is not null) as NOW_YR_JUN ,(select count(distinct mon_7) from unique_id where mon_7 is not null) as NOW_YR_JUL ,(select count(distinct mon_8) from unique_id where mon_8 is not null) as NOW_YR_AUG ,(select count(distinct mon_9) from unique_id where mon_9 is not null) as NOW_YR_SEP ,(select count(distinct mon_10) from unique_id where mon_10 is not null) as NOW_YR_OCT ,(select count(distinct mon_11) from unique_id where mon_11 is not null) as NOW_YR_NOV ,(select count(distinct mon_12) from unique_id where mon_12 is not null) as NOW_YR_DEC )
